claims.statement: DMart Ready's vision is to deliver almost all online orders in six hours.
claims.quote: Our vision is to deliver almost all our orders in six hours. And I think for the basket value, see, the DMart Ready shopper is not shopping for immediacy.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: The company is open to raising reasonable debt if great real estate acquisition opportunities arise.
claims.quote: We've discussed this internally. Reasonable debt is fine. I mean, so if we get great opportunities from a real estate acquisition standpoint, we are happy to raise that, but limited, under control.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: DMart Ready currently delivers around 11% of its orders within three hours and 65% within 12 hours.
facts.quote: And, in fact, we already have around 11% or thereabouts of our orders being delivered in three hours. We have 65% of our orders being delivered in 12 hours already.

facts.statement: Reduction in return on capital is primarily attributed to accelerated property acquisitions and higher capital employed.
facts.quote: I think the reduction in ROC is primarily because of accelerated property acquisitions and the capital employed because of that, which effectively should be seen in a positive light because that means that we are looking at a larger inventory of stores which are going to come in the future.

facts.statement: Real estate costs and per location prices are going up, which has deteriorated fixed asset turnover.
facts.quote: the reality is that real estate costs also are going up, which is being featured on the slide three on page 12, where the fixed asset turnover has slightly deteriorated because a combination of both, the per location prices are going up and we have some of these new stores which have opened, which are of higher value.

facts.statement: In the non-store area, the company experienced rapid inflation on warehousing rentals and employee wages.
facts.quote: Second is in the non-store area, we found that there has been a rapid inflation on warehousing, whether it is warehousing rentals, warehousing employees, there has been unprecedented inflation in wages there.
